hotels.title: Cradle Mountain Alpine Chalet Retreat with Nightly A$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Unplug and escape to the great Cradle Mountain, set on the edge of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Tasmanian wilderness. Experience the untamed beauty of the dramatic alpine landscape with breathtaking views from your mountain chalet and encounter Tasmania's diverse wildlife just steps from your door. Hike the famous Overland Track, explore the national park by canoe or on horseback and admire the serene Dove Lake at the base of the mountain. Relax with a glass of wine and nibble on some local cheese and truffles as you unwind after a day outdoors, taking in the peace and quiet around you. Be immersed in nature from the moment you arrive, with the landscape inviting you to sit back and admire your surroundings, and acres of true rugged wilderness calling you on a wild adventure.

hotels.title: Charming Cradle Mountain Wilderness Retreat with Onsite Dining
hotels.description: Whisk away a special someone for some nature-filled romance with a tranquil stay at this stunning Cradle Mountain escape. Uncover a shining crown jewel deep in Tasmania's breathtaking alpine region with rustic charm and modern comfort in cosy cabins and timber-built suites. Enjoy everything from thrilling bushwalks through the thriving reserves to a moment of rejuvenation at the Waldheim Alpine Spa. Sample the Highland Restaurant's paddock-to-plate philosophy, or for something a little more casual, enjoy a hearty meal and warming nightcap at the lodge’s Tavern Bar & Bistro while overlooking sprawling natural beauty.
